# condition-gates

> Conditions as nachprüfbare, sessionübergreifende Gates für LLM-Agenten und autonome Workflows.

## Overview

- **Repository:** https://github.com/ellmos-ai/condition-gates
- **Primary Language:** Python (>=3.10)
- **Architecture:** USMC Shared Memory with Standalone SQLite Fallback (`~/.condition-gates/gates.db`)
- **Status:** Private (internal development)
- **Version:** 0.1.1
- **Ecosystem:** ellmos-ai / open-bricks
- **Last Checked:** 2026-09-10

## Core Concept

Conditions as **gates**: a sub-step stays blocked until its condition is **proven** met by a tool query. Gates survive the end of a session and an abort.
Closing a gate via `meet()` without evidence fails by design (fail-closed proof requirement).

## Important Files

- `README.md`: English documentation, architecture diagrams, CLI reference, invariants
- `README_de.md`: German documentation (full 1:1 parity)
- `condition_gates/core.py`: GateBook class, GateError, lifecycle validation
- `condition_gates/store.py`: Storage backends (USMC and SQLite), append-only event stream
- `condition_gates/cli.py`: Command line interface (`doctor`, `list`, `open`, `meet`, `drop`)
- `gates.py`: Standalone CLI launcher without prior package installation
- `ellmos-module.v2.json`: ELLMOS module descriptor
- `MARKETING-LOG.txt`: Target personas, discoverability strategy, future recommendations
- `CHANGELOG.md`: Version history and change log
- `PRIVATE.txt`: Private repository guardrail

## CLI Usage

```bash
python -m condition_gates doctor [--json]
python -m condition_gates list [--all] [--json]
python -m condition_gates open "<condition>" --blocks "<what is blocked>" --proof "<proof path>" [--json]
python -m condition_gates meet <id> --evidence "<proof text from the tool query>" [--json]
python -m condition_gates drop <id> --reason "<why it is moot>" [--json]
```

## Python API Usage

```python
from condition_gates import GateBook
book = GateBook()
gate = book.open("system time >= 06:00", blocks="report-job", proof="time-probe")
book.meet(gate["gate_id"], "time-probe: 06:16 Europe/Berlin")
```
